Title: How to conduct a bibliometric analysis: An overview and guidelines
Abstract: Bibliometric analysis is a popular and rigorous method for exploring and analyzing large volumes of scientific data. It enables us to unpack the evolutionary nuances of a specific field, while shedding light on the emerging areas in that field. (c) 2021 Elsevier Inc.
Author Keywords: Bibliometric analysis; Guidelines; Performance analysis; Science mapping
